principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is not open for extension with new shapes. Every time a new shape needs to be supported, the sum method must be modified to include logic specific to that shape.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for shapes with an area method that each shape class implements. This will enable the AreaCalculator to work with any new shape by simply calling the area method.
